what: Master Version 2.20 — a permanent Row ID on every catalog row: a new last column "Row ID" on each of the 51 item tabs, one ID per row that has an item number (CATALOG_ROW_ID_PLAN_2026-10-04, Step 3). Nothing else on the sheet changes.
idRule: 10 characters from 23456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ (no 0/O, no 1/I/L), random, minted by the app's own rrNewRowId (app/config.js, v0.9.1880) with ONE taken-set across the whole master; never reused.
rowRule: a row gets an ID when the app reads an item number on it (parseMasterRow, trimmed) — the rows the master-list check's row-id-missing rule covers; blank rows and rows without a number get none.
columnRule: the first column after the last header/data column of the tab (the Atlas Z image links in column W, which has no header, are kept: its Row ID goes to X); a tab whose grid has no spare column gets ONE column appended first.
rowFormat: [item number as the sheet shows it, variation, Row ID, sheet row when planned (a hint — rows move)]
